000007: #
000008: # ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW:
000009: # Stateless long-polling Telegram bot for OpenWrt routers managing the
000010: # 'podkop' package (sing-box wrapper). Written in strict POSIX ash.
000011: #
000012: # KEY SUBSYSTEMS:
000013: # 1. Fallback Транспорт: Podkop SOCKS5 -> Резервные SOCKS -> Custom Proxy
000014: #    -> WARP Rescue -> Direct -> Emergency IPs. Atomic IPC via mv for watchdog <-> main loop.
000015: # 2. UCI Native Core: direct uci read/write, protected by flock.
000016: #    uci_list_clean + set -f replaces eval for safe list splitting.
000017: # 3. Dynamic State Machine: STATE_FILE for multi-step text inputs
000018: # 4. Sub-Function Routing: _handle_proxy / _handle_settings / _handle_lists /
000019: #    _handle_dns / _handle_bot / _handle_sections
000020: # 5. Background Health Daemon: 5 watchdog checks (TG connectivity, sing-box,
000021: #    SOCKS probe, proxy leaf change, route degradation). Alerts on tier4/tier5.
000022: # 6. Active Outbound Probe: geo (ipapi.co + Cloudflare + Google), service
000023: #    reachability (12 services including Telegram Bot API), 2-stage throughput
000024: #    (32KB block detection + 8MB speed measurement).
000025: #

004974: send_weekly_report() {
004975:     # mode: scheduled (default) advances weekly baselines; manual is a read-only snapshot.
004976:     local _wr_mode="${1:-scheduled}" _wr_mid="${2:-}"
004977:     local _wr_lock="${BOT_DIR}/weekly_report.lock"
004978:     local _wr_now="" _wr_mtime="" _wr_age="" _wr_stale=0
004979:     local _wr_keyboard
004980:     _wr_keyboard="{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"cmd_maintenance\"},{\"text\":\"🏠 Меню\",\"callback_data\":\"/menu\"}]]}"
004981: 
004982:     # Atomic directory lock. Do not identify the owner by PID: after a restart
004983:     # an old PID can be reused by another podkop_bot process and suppress reports
004984:     # indefinitely. Old PID-based locks from 0.17.3-0.17.7 are removed at once;
004985:     # current locks expire after five minutes.
004986:     if ! mkdir "$_wr_lock" 2>/dev/null; then
004987:         if [ -f "$_wr_lock/pid" ]; then
004988:             _wr_stale=1
004989:         else
004990:             _wr_now=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
004991:             _wr_mtime=$(date -r "$_wr_lock" +%s 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$_wr_lock" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
004992:             case "$_wr_now" in ''|*[!0-9]*) _wr_now=0 ;; esac

006469: _handle_proxy() {
006470:     local cmd="$1" mid="$2" text="$3" state="$4"
006471:     local sec=$(get_active_section)
006472:     local per_page=10
006473: 
006474:     if [ "$cmd" = "STATE_INPUT" ]; then
006475:         # Nav escape: persistent keyboard buttons cancel current state
006476:         case "$text" in
006477:             "🏠 Меню"|"🏠 Menu"|"/menu"|"main_menu")
006478:                 rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
006479:                 delete_message "$mid"
006480:                 _handle_bot "/menu" "" "" ""
006481:                 return ;;
006482:             "📊 Статус"|"📊 Status"|"cmd_status"|"/status")
006483:                 rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
006484:                 delete_message "$mid"
006485:                 _handle_bot "cmd_status" "" "" ""
006486:                 return ;;
006487:         esac
006488: 
006489:         # During confirmation, ignore extra text and keep the pending URL.
006490:         case "$state" in
006491:             pending_sub_url_*|pending_forkop_sub_url|pending_netshift_sub_url)
006492:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Используйте кнопки <b>Подтвердить</b> или <b>Отмена</b> выше.' "$E_WARN")" \
006493:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"❌ Отмена\",\"callback_data\":\"proxy_menu\"}]]}"
006494:                 return
006495:                 ;;
006496:         esac
006497: 
006498:         # Forkop: edit the URL field of a native child subscription_url section.
006499:         if [ "$state" = "wait_forkop_sub_url" ]; then
006500:             local _sub_sec _sub_child _new_url _old_url
006501:             _sub_sec=$(sed -n '2p' "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
006502:             _sub_child=$(sed -n '3p' "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
006503:             rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
006504:             delete_message "$mid"
006505:             _new_url=$(printf '%s' "$text" | tr -d '\r\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
006506:             if ! printf '%s' "$_new_url" | grep -qE '^https?://'; then
006507:                 send_message "$(printf '%s <b>Некорректный URL.</b>\nURL должен начинаться с <code>http://</code> или <code>https://</code>.' "$E_ERR")" \
006508:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"proxy_menu\"}]]}"
006509:                 return
006510:             fi
006511:             forkop_subscription_child_valid "$_sub_child" "$_sub_sec" || {
006512:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Источник подписки больше не найден. Откройте список заново.' "$E_WARN")" \
006513:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"proxy_menu\"}]]}"
006514:                 return
006515:             }
006516:             _old_url=$(uci -q get "${PODKOP_UCI}.${_sub_child}.url" 2>/dev/null)
006517:             printf '%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n' "pending_forkop_sub_url" "$_sub_sec" "$_sub_child" "$_new_url" > "$STATE_FILE"
006518:             send_message "$(printf '%s <b>Заменить URL подписки?</b>\n\n<b>Текущий URL:</b>\n<code>%s</code>\n\n<b>Новый URL:</b>\n<code>%s</code>\n\n<i>Остальные настройки источника не изменятся.</i>' \
006519:                 "$E_WARN" "$(html_escape "$_old_url")" "$(html_escape "$_new_url")")" \
006520:                 "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_OK} Подтвердить\",\"callback_data\":\"do_confirm_forkop_sub_url\"},{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Отмена\",\"callback_data\":\"proxy_menu\"}]]}"
006521:             return
006522:         fi
006523: 
006524:         # NetShift: edit one selected URL while preserving the rest of the list.
006525:         if [ "$state" = "wait_netshift_sub_url" ]; then

009905: # Report a failed transaction from a button path: toast always, plus a full
009906: # message when the config was left in a changed state (rc=4).
009907: _fk_txn_report() {
009908:     local _rc="$1" _mid="$2" _back="$3"
009909:     CB_ANSWER_TEXT="$(_fk_txn_toast "$_rc")"
009910:     [ "$_rc" = "4" ] && send_message "$(_fk_txn_fail_msg 4)" \
009911:         "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"${_back}\"}]]}"
009912: }

009914: # ---- Conditions storage model (verified against luci-app-forkop section.js) --
009915: # domain / ip_cidr: ONE multiline scalar option. The domain scalar carries the
009916: # whole family inline — a bare line is a suffix match, prefixes full:/keyword:/
009917: # regex: select exact/keyword/regex. LuCI's afterWrite unsets the legacy
009918: # domain_suffix / domain_keyword / domain_regex lists and *_text fields.
009919: # ports / source_ip_cidr: real UCI lists.
009920: # Backend parses the scalar with text_list_values: split by newline, '//' and
009921: # '#' start comments.
009922: _fk_cond_is_scalar() { case "$1" in domain|ip_cidr) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac; }

010377:         send_or_edit "$_mid" "${E_ERR} $(html_escape "$_msg")" "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"${_back:-urltest_filters_menu}\"}]]}"

010384: _plus_urltest_txn_report() {
010385:     local _rc="$1" _mid="$2" _back="$3" _short _full _already=0
010386:     [ "$CB_ANSWER_TEXT" = "__ANSWERED__" ] && _already=1

011498: # Forkop global DNS is an ordered DynamicList. 0.19.8 edits the real list rather

014312: _handle_bot() {
014313:     local cmd="$1" mid="$2" text="$3" state="$4"
014314: 
014315:     if [ "$cmd" = "STATE_INPUT" ]; then
014316:         rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
014317:         if [ "$state" = "wait_restart_router_confirm" ]; then
014318:             local input; input=$(printf "%s" "$text" | tr -d '\r\n\t ')
014319:             if [ "$input" = "YES" ]; then
014320:                 send_message "$(printf '%s <b>Перезагрузка %s…</b>\nБот возобновит работу примерно через минуту.' "$E_OFF" "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/hostname 2>/dev/null || echo "Роутер")")" ""
014321:                 logger -t podkop-bot "[Restart Router] Manual reboot requested via Telegram"
014322:                 sleep 2
014323:                 reboot
014324:             else
014325:                 delete_message "$mid"
014326:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Перезагрузка отменена. Введено: <code>%s</code>' "$E_BACK" "$(html_escape "$input")")" \
014327:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"cmd_maintenance\"}]]}"
014328:             fi
014329:             return
014330:         elif [ "$state" = "wait_custom_proxy" ]; then
014331:             delete_message "$mid"
014332:             local safe_link=$(printf "%s" "$text" | tr -d '\r\n\t ')
014333:             if echo "$safe_link" | grep -qE '^(http|https|socks5|socks5h)://'; then
014334:                 uci set podkop_bot.settings.custom_proxy="$safe_link"; uci_commit_safe podkop_bot
014335:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Прокси бота сохранён.' "$E_OK")" ""
014336:                 _handle_fallback_socks "net_proxies_menu" "" "" ""
014337:             else
014338:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Адрес должен начинаться с http://, https://, socks5:// или socks5h://' "$E_ERR")" \
014339:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"net_proxies_menu\"}]]}"
014340:             fi
014341:         elif [ "$state" = "wait_bind_iface" ]; then
014342:             delete_message "$mid"
014343:             local safe_iface=$(printf "%s" "$text" | tr -d '\r\n')
014344:             if echo "$safe_iface" | grep -q '[[:space:]]'; then
014345:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Имя интерфейса содержит пробелы.' "$E_ERR")" \
014346:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"bot_settings\"}]]}"
014347:             elif ! ip link show "$safe_iface" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
014348:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Интерфейс <code>%s</code> не существует.' "$E_ERR" "$safe_iface")" \
014349:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"bot_settings\"}]]}"
014350:             else
014351:                 uci set podkop_bot.settings.bind_interface="$safe_iface"; uci_commit_safe podkop_bot
014352:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Бот привязан к интерфейсу: <code>%s</code>' "$E_OK" "$safe_iface")" ""
014353:                 _handle_bot "bot_settings" "" "" ""
014354:             fi
014355:         fi
014356:         return
014357:     fi

017192:         # Single jq call — fields joined with U+001F (Unit Separator, not shell whitespace).
017193:         # @tsv used \t which is whitespace for read, causing field shift when callback_id empty.
017194:         # Fields: chat_id, chat_type, raw_text, callback_id, u_name, user_id,
017195:         #         is_bot_sender, sender_chat_id, sender_chat_type, sender_chat_title,
017196:         #         CALLBACK_MSG_ID, message_thread_id
017197:         _upd_flat=$(printf '%s' "$update" | jq -r '
017198:             [
017199:                 (.message.chat.id // .callback_query.message.chat.id // ""),
017200:                 (.message.chat.type // .callback_query.message.chat.type // ""),
017201:                 (.message.text // .callback_query.data // ""),
017202:                 (.callback_query.id // ""),
017203:                 (.message.from.username // .callback_query.from.username // ""),
017204:                 (.message.from.id // .callback_query.from.id // ""),
017205:                 ((.message.from.is_bot // .callback_query.from.is_bot // false) | tostring),
017206:                 (.message.sender_chat.id // .callback_query.message.sender_chat.id // ""),
017207:                 (.message.sender_chat.type // .callback_query.message.sender_chat.type // ""),
017208:                 (.message.sender_chat.title // .callback_query.message.sender_chat.title // ""),
017209:                 (.message.message_id // .callback_query.message.message_id // ""),
017210:                 (.message.message_thread_id // .callback_query.message.message_thread_id // "")
017211:             ] | join("\u001f")
017212:         ' 2>/dev/null)
